advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add an assertion that observability.sh publishes mcp_healthy with NO --dimensions (and/or that the mcp_serving_path_down alarm declares no dimensions), pinning the dimensionless-on-both-sides contract the diff calls load-bearing.
evidence: observability.sh:120-121 publishes mcp_healthy with no --dimensions: `aws cloudwatch put-metric-data --region "$REGION" --namespace "$NS" --metric-name mcp_healthy --unit Count --value "$mcp_ok"` — contrast the sibling gerrit_healthy at observability.sh:56-58 which appends `--dimensions InstanceId="$IID"`
observability.sh:114-116: 'DIMENSIONLESS on both sides ... a dimension on one side only silently unmatches' — declared load-bearing
monitoring_9ea3.tf:24-26: 'Dimensions = NONE — dimensionless on BOTH sides ... a dimension on one side only silently unmatches and the alarm sits in INSUFFICIENT_DATA forever'
`_values` (test lines 105-112) splits argv and reads only --metric-name/--value; it never inspects --dimensions, so adding a dimension changes nothing it checks

ABSENCE: search for 'mcp_healthy' and 'mcp_serving_path_down' under tests/unit returned no matches, and the shell test contains no 'dimension' token — neither producer nor alarm side asserts the dimensionless binding
advisory.finding: The dimensionless-metric contract that the diff declares load-bearing on both sides is untested: no assertion pins that observability.sh §1b publishes mcp_healthy WITHOUT --dimensions, so a regression re-adding `--dimensions InstanceId="$IID"` (as the adjacent gerrit_healthy publish does) — the exact silent unmatch the diff warns 'sits in INSUFFICIENT_DATA forever' — passes every test green.
scenarios: A future edit copies the gerrit_healthy publish idiom and adds `--dimensions InstanceId="$IID"` to the mcp_healthy publish, silently breaking alarm matching while all tests stay green
advisory.suggested_fix: In test_observability_mcp_health_9ea3.py, add a test that scans the aws.log line for the mcp_healthy put-metric-data and asserts `--dimensions` is absent from it, e.g. locate the line whose split parts contain both '--metric-name' and 'mcp_healthy' and assert '--dimensions' not in those parts.
